scientific_integrity: A proved fixed-field, large-dimension asymptotic for finite rational automorphism groups of perfect evolution algebras; direct finite tests are independent regression evidence, not infinite certificates.
scientific_limitations: Fixed prime-power field q>=3; no uniform-in-q assertion.
Structure matrix sampled uniformly from GL_n(F_q), rather than the singular or sparse ensembles.
Claim concerns rational finite automorphism groups, not automorphism group schemes.
Novelty/priority based on inspected relevant sources; broader implicit reductions may exist.
The binary-field q=2 case is excluded from the new scientific claim.
title: Sharp generic rigidity and orbit asymptotics for perfect evolution algebras over nonbinary finite fields
